title: R-CES Final Image-Rule Annotation (unified)
description: ONE record shape for every annotated image-rule pair, used by BOTH the human gold file (rces_pilot_pairs.jsonl, source=human) and the isolated model full-pipeline baseline (rces_qwen_full_baseline.jsonl, source=model_full -- a generic model-baseline token, with the actual model in `model`). The `source` field discriminates the two; the files stay physically separate so the Stage-1 interactive tool only ever reads/writes gold and model output can never leak into ground truth. Judgment fields accept the placeholder 'to_be_annotated' so a freshly seeded gold row (annotation_status=pending) also validates; the stricter semantic invariants (observed/missing subset of the rule's required_checkpoints and disjoint, critical_missing = missing INTERSECT critical, no baseline value reflow into gold) are enforced by tmp/validate_rces_pairs.py.

pair_id.description: rces_pilot_* = gold/baseline pairs; rces_crop_* = isolated crop-augmentation training samples; rces_enhance_* = test-set expansion candidates.

rule_id.description: Must reference an existing rule_id in data/rule/rule.json.

rule_role.description: Candidate-selection provenance from rule-retrieval construction; not a visual label and not an ESC feature.

image_weak_label.description: Selection-provenance weak label; not an ESC feature.

weak_candidate_category.description: Legacy provenance slot. Under SigLIP2 pair generation this stores the target rule category, not a weak-label-derived category.

decidability.description: decidable = single image settles it (incl. rule not applicable). partially_decidable = a critical checkpoint is unresolved in this image. undecidable = rule needs non-visual evidence. 'to_be_annotated' only while annotation_status=pending.

compliance_label.description: not_applicable = subject absent (a decidable decision). unknown pairs with partially_decidable / undecidable. 'to_be_annotated' only while pending.

evidence_sufficiency_label.description: ESC's named gold, DERIVED from decidability (codebook §7: decidable->sufficient, partially_decidable->partial, undecidable->insufficient) and validated by tmp/validate_rces_pairs.py; never hand-typed. 'to_be_annotated' only while pending.

observed_checkpoints.description: Checkpoint keys readable from this image. Subset of the rule's required_checkpoints; disjoint from missing_checkpoints (enforced by validate_rces_pairs.py).

missing_checkpoints.description: Checkpoint keys unresolved in this image. Subset of required_checkpoints; disjoint from observed_checkpoints.

critical_missing_checkpoints.description: Derived, never hand-filled: missing_checkpoints INTERSECT rule.critical_checkpoints.

visual_evidence.description: Visible facts supporting the annotation. For gold these are filled in Stage 2 under locked judgment; empty while pending/judged.

missing_information.description: Key information missing for the visual-screening conclusion.

source.description: human = human Stage-1 judgment, the ground truth (any later free-text in visual_evidence/missing_information is post-processing under the locked judgment, not gold supervision). model_full = a model did everything (full-pipeline baseline; the actual model is recorded in `model`), never ground truth.

annotation_status.description: Gold workflow: pending -> judged -> described -> reviewed. Baseline rows are always model_complete.

double_annotation.description: True for the ~20% double-annotated gold subset (prioritising partially_decidable and requires_external_evidence). Always false for baseline rows.

description_flag_conflict.description: Stage 2 raised FLAG_CONFLICT for human review (gold).

base_image_id.description: Crop-augmentation only: the train-split mother image this crop was cut from.

crop_bbox.description: Crop-augmentation only: [left, top, right, bottom] pixel box of the crop in the mother image.

augmentation.description: Crop-augmentation provenance tag (source stays human; these rows are train-only, never gold, never evaluated).

retrieval_method.description: Crop-augmentation only: which retriever bound this crop's rule. SigLIP-224 runs first; crops it does NOT call an opening are re-judged by the 9B VLM.

retrieval_score.description: Crop-augmentation only: the binding retriever's score for this (crop, rule) — SigLIP cosine similarity or the VLM hierarchical rank score.
